trajectory.thought: The leader is a seeded baseline (median of full pool) and the verdict is 'indistinguishable' — the runner-up is not statistically better. The series is close to white noise with unstable rankings and highly correlated errors, so the robust median of the full pool is well-suited. More turns are unlikely to turn noise into a real gain.

action_args.justification: The series has strong trend and seasonality but a near-white-noise spectrum, making most variation unpredictable. Model ranking is highly unstable (Kendall tau 0.018) and errors are strongly correlated (mean 0.891, only 4 independent groups), so fitted weights or small-pool selections would overfit to window-specific noise. The median of the full 19-model pool is the most robust combination: it is insensitive to outlying model errors, does not depend on a stable ranking, and benefits from the small residual diversity among the 4 independent error groups. The leader is a seed baseline and the runner-up is statistically indistinguishable, confirming no further gain is available.
